name: Butterfly Falls to base of Birdwing Falls
description:
Butterfly Falls
Date: Sunday 26th June 2022
Leader: Luen Warneke
Image credit: https://wanderstories.space/
Rated: 4 medium - a little rock hopping and scrambling with some loose and slippery surfaces with optional walk to base of falls.
Duration: Half-day walk, 6 hours return
Distance: ~11km return
Elevation gain: ~290m

Description:
This is a medium grade, half-day, cross-country bushwalk on a rough track in Girringun National Park through a mix of woodland and rainforest then creek rock-hopping.
The terrain includes wait-a-while vine, long grass, uneven footings, rock hopping, bush bashing, steep climbs, and some exposed cliffs.
Waterfalls include Euphorion Falls, Ornithoptera Falls, and Birdwing Falls.
For those who want a bit extra, we’ll do an optional, relatively short, off-track walk down to the base of Birdwing Falls 

Meeting (RSVP REQUIRED): 
Contact the walk leader for more details, such as the meeting location.
Meeting at 6am.
It is a 148 km 2 hr drive to the trailhead near Ingham from Townsville. The roads are sealed and cattle may be on the roads.
Estimate back at the trailhead at midday, for the 2-hour drive back to Townsville. Arriving back in the outskirts of Townsville around 3 pm.
If carpooling, please bring a change of clothes in the car and offer the driver some fuel money.

Notes:
The group size is limited to 8 people.
The club recommends that any natural water sources must be suitably treated before consumption.
The fee is $5 for non-members.
You must be over 18 years old to participate.

RSVP (REQUIRED):
To RSVP, please fill out the form below
https://forms.gle/BCyK6FmJkSDPrDk59
To find out more information, contact the walk leader Luen Warneke at info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com
It's up to the walk leader to accept your walk registration. 
Club members are given priority at the leader's discretion.

name: Three Lagoons
description:
Three Lagoons
Date: Sunday 19th June 2022
Leader: Keith

A one-day bushwalk visiting three mountain jungle lagoons and waterfalls. 

Rated: 4 Difficult – mix of rainforest bush track walking and off-track jungle bashing and rock hopping/scrambling. 

Duration: Approx 8 hours of constant bushwalking II 
Distance: up to 20 km II  
Elevation gain: ~400m

Description:
This activity is in Paluma Range National Park, Mt Spec Region, based on Crystal and Dolby Creeks. Starts and finishes at Paluma Dam.

A full-day bushwalk comprising rough bush tracks, then off-track jungle bashing and rockhopping / scrambling. Route involves trip hazards, loose and slippery surfaces, steep sections, risk of cuts and scratches from jungle vegetation, and exposed ledges. In some areas there will be tangled vines and wait-a-while to enjoy.

Suitable for fit bushwalkers who can maintain a good pace over the full day in remote conditions. 

What to bring : 
Day pack, food / snacks for the day, water 2 lt minimum (refill from creeks or carry 4 lt water), long sleeve clothing and good rugged footwear (to protect from sun, scratches, stings, and bites), electrolytes, insect repellent (leeches, mozzies), hat, sunscreen, personal first aid kit (basic), and eye protection. Also head torch and whistle.

If you are uncomfortable using creek water for drinking water refill (after treating suitably), then carry 4 lt min for the day, or more to suit your requirements. Note that the club recommends that any natural water sources must be suitably treated before consumption. 

The group size is limited to 12 people
The fee is $5 for non-members. 
You must be over 18 years old to participate

Meeting Point and Time:
Meet at Paluma Dam outer car park at 0830. There is no car pooling offered by the club.

We estimate to be back at the dam car park at 5pm. 

Leader : Keith 

Please read ‘Walker Guidelines’ and ‘What to Bring’ at these links:
Walker Guidelines - https://www.townsvillebushwalkingclub.com/about/walker-guidelines
Walk Together - https://www.townsvillebushwalkingclub.com/about/walk-together
What to Bring? - https://www.townsvillebushwalkingclub.com/equipment/what-to-bring

To register, use the following online form - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd53jDZh_98_KG4E38OzC2pLa0uGrYQE9ypZiMWdwM7q7sbnQ/viewform

It's up to the walk leader to accept your walk registration. Club members are given priority at the leader's discretion.

name: Lower Crystal Creek
description:
Lower Big Crystal Creek
Date: Saturday 11th June 2022
Leader: Hue Plumtree
Rated: 5 Difficult - Rock hopping and scrambling over large rocks with very steep sections, and some loose and slippery surfaces.

Duration: 7-9 hours of constant bushwalking II Distance: ~10kms II  Elevation gain: ~100m

Description:
This is a very hard, full-day, cross-country, creek-based bushwalk with no tracks in the lower section of Big Cyrstal Creek. Cyrstal Creek is home to giant granite boulders, waterfalls, and other rugged landscapes.
The terrain includes uneven footings, rock hopping, scrambling, bush bashing, steep climbs, and exposed ledges. The vegetation is a mix of woodland and rainforest.
For fit experienced bushwalkers who can maintain a good pace over the full day. 

It is difficult to exit from this walk if you have difficulty or are slow. This is a remote area with no convenient means to exit the walk after the start. Once we start, you will be moving at a good pace.

This section of Big Crystal Creek is very technical and is only recommended for the more advanced adventurer that has experience in grade 5 creeks, rock hopping, and scrambling.

Notes:
The group size is limited to 10 people
The fee is $5 for non-members. 
You must be over 18 years old to participate

Meeting Point and Time (RSVP REQUIRED):
Meet in the dirt car park at Caltex Yabulu 25km north of Townsville at 6:30am. Pre-car pool briefing and paperwork check.
Carpool to Mango Tree Car Park arriving at approximately 7:30am.
We estimate to be back at the car park at 4pm and at the Caltex Yabulu at 5pm. 

If carpooling from Caltex Yabulu to Crystal Creek, please bring a change of clothes in the car and offer the driver some fuel money. 

RSVP (REQUIRED)
Please RSVP at this link - https://forms.gle/GdpVcriYQtyTdzWn8

To find out more information, contact the walk leader Hue Plumtree at info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com

It's up to the walk leader to accept your walk registration. Club members are given priority at the leader's discretion.
